description: OP-01 spend guard policy. Generous starting caps in warn posture per the plan's risk note — observe the measured distribution before tightening or switching to block. Evaluation scope: a tenant-bound process evaluates daily/mission caps per bound tenant (that tenant's tenant_overrides entry, over that tenant's metrics partitions of every tier plus the system partition) and ignores (debug-logs) a different requested tenant — tenant authorization is the scope layer's job, so brokered missions and warn posture are never blocked by it; an unbound process evaluates a requested tenant's caps over that tenant's partitions plus the system partition, or the global caps over every partition when none is requested. Tenant slugs are compared trimmed and lower-cased. Spend is read through the governed numbers-only enforcement aggregate, so the caller's persona never reduces it.
